environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed in VPC with default security group. Split.io feature flag 'enable_url_enrichment' is set to treatment 'on' for all users (100% rollout). Lambda has IAM role with AmazonEC2ReadOnlyAccess. No VPC endpoint policies restricting outbound. IMDSv1 enabled on any reachable EC2 instances in the VPC. Lambda function URL is publicly accessible with AuthType NONE.
